brief: The canvas displays a continuous, slow-moving cosmic tide composed of overlapping, translucent circles. Interspersed within this flowing tide are shimmering pointillist stars. These stars are accompanied by visible trails of prismatic light, and occasionally, these trails dissipate, resolving into clusters of sparkling, visible dust. The entire environment flows continuously across the screen, maintaining a constant, ethereal rhythm with no required viewer input.

statement: This sketch portrays a serene cosmic tide of overlapping translucent circles that slowly flow across the canvas, evoking an ethereal underwater or celestial environment. Scattered throughout this tide are shimmering pointillist stars that leave trails of prismatic light behind them. These star trails occasionally resolve into bursts of sparkling dust clusters, adding a sense of dynamic transformation to the static background. The continuous, slow motion creates a hypnotic rhythm that maintains visual interest without requiring any viewer input, capturing the essence of an endless, flowing cosmic dance.
